digest.component_or_area: Pandoc markdown conversion and render pass
propositions: The _convert function resolves _pandoc_timeout() on every unit invocation, triggering redundant git rev-parse --show-toplevel subprocess calls via load_config() before its result-cache lookup.

An 884-unit production trace observed 1,770 total Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 886 git-root discovery) compared to the repaired trace of 887 Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 3 one-time probes) with identical byte outputs.

Timeout resolution must be moved to the render-pass boundary and threaded through _render_unit and _convert as optional parameters while preserving safe defaults for direct callers and per-unit fallback behavior.
A held-out behavioral oracle with three renderable units must verify exactly one _pandoc_timeout() resolution per render pass and reject per-unit resolution via defect seeding.
